display_name: Tri 六设置源接收机分项更新迁移诊断
description: Existing E20/E30: source RX held-out true-label CE after disposable component-removal updates.
authorization: 2026-11-16 user requested existing-checkpoint source component diagnosis and compute cost; no running experiment changes.

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Python; CPU 2 threads; FP32

data.dataset: Main/2/3/4/6-source ManySig and ten-class ManyRx, original immutable contracts

roles.L_s: true-label update and record-disjoint reference; held RX excluded per cell
roles.U_s: blind update input; held RX excluded except explicit two-RX auxiliary

data.support_query_ref: not applicable; source-only, no target query

permissions.claim_scope: single-step source transfer only; reference RX were seen during parent training

checkpoint.initialization: Disposable original Tri E20 and E30 checkpoints
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: checked at execution: scratch, source-only, same seed and source contract
checkpoint.selection_rule: One seed 2026092701; E20 and E30 native optimizer-restart boundaries; first/middle/last sorted source RX

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two CPU threads; no GPU workers
execution.stop_rule: Abort on protocol, checkpoint, gradient closure, finite-value, reference overlap, or native backward mismatch. Never stop other processes.

metric_names: conditional component benefit vs full U
native computation time and extra diagnostic time

rows.purpose: Compare other-source-RX CE under full U and component removals
rows.seed_notes: Model2026092701; reference seed model+RX; update seed model+100*RX; same samples across checkpoint snapshots.
rows.scenario: source-only L and U; no target
rows.budget_ref: E20/E30 x up to 3 held RX x 8 arms; two-source adds sample-disjoint mode

notes: CPU source-only diagnostic; no formal training and no new target evaluation.
E20/E30 use fresh AdamW moments as the original next segment does; not arbitrary mid-trajectory state.
All 5 U components reconstruct the original scalar and gradient; original cap1 guard recomputed for every removal.
Source true-label raw clean CE is an imperfect transfer proxy, not an unseen-RX or satellite performance claim.
Two-source strict leave-one-RX-out disables all cross-RX pair terms; auxiliary sample-disjoint mode measures them without a receiver-held-out claim.
Ordinary PL at Tri checkpoint is a one-step objective comparator, not a trained PL model.
Published test summaries only enter separate retrospective report; never diagnostic sampler or model update.
No source V/U truth/target inputs; all shadow models and optimizer states discarded.
